Video test: full white, full black, and RGB screens + grid/line test (to confirm no dead pixels/lines).
Photo of the remote and a short clip proving remote controls the TV.
Clip testing at least one HDMI input and sound (volume/mute).
response.reason: The photos confirm an LG smart TV is working, but they do not verify the claimed exact 86-inch model/size or panel condition details that determine the correct price. Without the model/size proof, a reliable worst-case price pick from the comparables isn’t possible.
